title: An Apple A Day...
description:
Round, apple-shaped mugs, each with a sculpted leaf at the rim and a stem for a handle. The glazes run from spring green to plum and deep blue, so every apple is a different variety. Each mug is sold separately.
Photo 3 -Green Apple -(M024), Available

alt: Four apple-shaped mugs in green, grey, blue and purple glazes, each with a leaf at the rim
